newsitem.title: UK: Weak gas oil dips jet price, glut pressures cargoe.
newsitem.headline: Weak gas oil dips jet price, glut pressures cargoe.

text.p: LONDON, Feb 5 Reuter) - Outright prices for jet fuel in NWE were marked sharply lower on Thursday as benchmark gas oil futures continued their retreat.
Traders said a glut of prompt cargoes and slack buying interest because of the downside volatility on gas oil were also keeping the pressure on cargo premiums.

Brokers said sellers were reluctant to offer cargoes into the void of buying interest but pegged notional levels for Feb deliveries around March IPE +$30 a tonne cif after trade into the U.K. for 10kt at the level on Wednesday.
FOB barge sellers were thought around $2 under cargoes.
Traders said volatility on Feb gas oil futures had left talk focusing on March related numbers.
